snippet.title: Farm Ricochet PvP Guide: All 9 Heroes, Abilities & 7 Winning Combos
snippet.description:
One single shot... and three enemy heroes go down! The Loot Goblin puts on his top hat and monocle to host the Arena Show: the complete Farm Ricochet PvP guide.

In this video:
- The rules, and the golden rule of PvP: on your turn, every one of your heroes deals damage, even the ones standing still
- Physics: weight, size, speed and ricochets
- All 9 heroes, their abilities and how to counter each one
- 7 combos: Hammer and Anvil, Marked Fury, Tank Dynamite, Pinball, Mercy Arrow, Pit Stop and Wrecking Ball
- The Goblin Challenge, defense tips, 3 team ideas and the Casual, Ranked and Private modes

Every play shown is a replay from the game's real PvP engine.

Play now: https://farmricochet.com

Audio available in English, Portuguese and Spanish: Settings 👉 Audio track.
